svg.title: Fresh query rows still read prefix keys
svg.desc: Full causal twelve-token prefill has seventy-eight pairs. Reusing eight prefix rows leaves forty-two pairs, including thirty-two reads of reused prefix keys and ten suffix pairs.

g.text: N = 12; reuse R = 8 prefix query rows
Causal attention includes the diagonal. Rows are queries; columns are keys.
Green: 32 suffix-to-prefix pairs. Blue on right: 10 suffix-to-suffix pairs.
Skipping old queries does not remove their KV from new queries’ attention.
